title: LedgerArtifactParams
description: Params for ledger.artifact. `id` alone reads the whole body, as every caller did before storage grew large. Either range field names a PAGE of a stored-rows artifact (nocx-t7xhe): the read returns only rows at or after `fromRow`, at most `rowLimit` of them, with the artifact's own coordinates. A range on any other media type is refused, because a row index means nothing for text or an SGR grid.

fromRow.description: Absolute index of the first stored row the caller wants; absent means the artifact's first row.

rowLimit.description: Most rows to return; absent means to the artifact's last stored row.
